html: Your body uses water to regulate temperature, cushion joints and carry nutrients. Fluid needs vary with activity, climate and health.

• Keep a refillable water bottle nearby
  • Drink more during hot weather and exercise
  • Fruits and vegetables also provide water
  • Pale yellow urine is a common sign of good hydration
Thirst, dark urine, dizziness and fatigue can be signs you need more fluids. Confusion, fainting or a rapid heartbeat need prompt medical care.

title: Staying hydrated
abstract: Why fluids matter and easy ways to drink enough during the day.
